name: 2027 NIDA International Forum
organizer: National Institute on Drug Abuse, International Program
description: The NIDA International Forum is an annual June meeting for substance use researchers, traditionally held alongside the College on Problems of Drug Dependence annual scientific meeting, with a poster session and no registration fee. The 2026 Forum was held virtually on 3 to 4 June 2026; the 2027 Forum has not been announced.

deadlines.label: Poster abstract submission
deadlines.note: Estimated from the 2026 deadline (22 March 2026 for a 3 to 4 June forum). Not published.

sources.note: 2026 Forum 3 to 4 June 2026, online, abstract deadline 22 March 2026, registration opened 27 January 2026.

notes: CPDD's 89th Annual Scientific Meeting is scheduled for 26 to 30 June 2027 in Toronto; if the Forum returns to an in person format it would likely be held alongside it, but no announcement exists.
